photos.c: To 29th January 1938 and the Belgrave 10 miles walking championship. Our picture shows J.Coleman (2nd), P.Wright (3rd), H.Churcher (1st) and L.Coleman (4th) slugging it out for the lead along Southside.

This photograph is part of the complete one taken at the Belgrave 50th Anniversary Dinner 1937 and shows as numbered some of the club's race walkers of that period. No 7 is Harold King (see obituary notice) others are 1. Chas Churcher, 2. Harry Churcher, 3. Joe Coleman, 4. Tommy Green, 5. Jack Bidgood and 6. Frank Elson.

The Walking Section congratulate Joe Coleman following his election to the President's office. L to R; Back row. Carl Lawton, Mike Scamell, John Keown John Newman, Russell Day, John Dunsford. Middle. John Morris, Fred Denny, Richard Dorman, JOE COLEMAN, John Llewellin,Ed. Crossingham, Tom Carter, Ted Stimpson, Kneeling; Graham Seatter, Ron Day, John Hall.
